races.paceDynamic: Paradise Park provides the only confirmed front-running threat, setting up a sustainable pace without early pressure from other prominent runners. Half Pint Daisy and Lily Grace may press forward but primarily seek prominent positions rather than outright leads. The bulk of this 12-runner field comprises hold-up horses who will rely on the closing stages, creating a race where stamina and timing matter more than early speed. This pace scenario strongly favours hold-up performers who can quicken late over the testing 2m4f trip on soft ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Gallop Benefits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Paradise Park maintains steady fractions without serious early pressure
scenarios.body: The genuine pace allows hold-up horses to conserve energy before unleashing their finishing kicks in the final half-mile. Quality closers with proven stamina reserves will have ideal conditions to time their runs.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Modest Pace Suits Handier Types
scenarios.trigger: If Paradise Park goes too slowly and prominent runners creep closer
scenarios.body: The lack of genuine pace becomes a scramble where horses positioned handily can dictate the finish. Those who can quicken from closer to the pace gain crucial advantage over deep closers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Strong Gallop Finds Out Stamina
scenarios.trigger: If Paradise Park is pressed hard by Half Pint Daisy or Lily Grace throughout
scenarios.body: The increased tempo over this extended trip on testing ground becomes a stamina examination. Only horses with proven staying power over similar conditions will cope with the demanding gallop.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates Wire-to-Wire
scenarios.trigger: If Paradise Park faces no serious challenges and dictates throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of pressure allows Paradise Park to control every fraction and kick clear when ready. Late closers struggle to make up significant ground against a horse who has conserved energy.

races.paceDynamic: Knead A Win and Doujadou are both confirmed front-runners who will contest the early pace, creating an honest gallop from the off. With both leaders having strong form on similar going conditions, expect a solid tempo throughout rather than a crawl. The sustained pace will stretch the field, testing stamina reserves over this extended 2m4f trip on testing ground. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses who can stay on when the pace-setters weaken, giving the tactical edge to horses like Grand Teton, Mr Rafiki and Shuil Rocco.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Late
scenarios.trigger: If both Knead A Win and Doujadou maintain their duel too long
scenarios.body: The honest pace will take its toll on soft ground, causing the leaders to fade in the final half-mile. Hold-up horses with stamina reserves will sweep past the tiring pace-setters.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one of Doujadou or Knead A Win gets first run on the field
scenarios.body: The winner will have enough left after being allowed to dictate on their own terms in the closing stages. Their proven form on similar conditions gives them the edge over less exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Tracker Strikes
scenarios.trigger: If Johnny's Belle or Guardami Ancora track the pace perfectly
scenarios.body: A horse sitting just off the leaders will have the perfect position to strike when the front-runners weaken. They avoid the early pace battle while staying close enough to pounce.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Unexposed Improver
scenarios.trigger: If Into The Blue or Pappariche show significant improvement from limited runs
scenarios.body: The Henderson and Williams newcomers could have more ability than their brief profiles suggest. Their stable form and potential progression could overcome the tactical disadvantage.

races.paceDynamic: Barford Brook and Bebe And Bean will ensure a genuine pace from the start, with both confirmed front-runners likely to contest the early lead over this sharp 2m trip. Their honest gallop will stretch the field and create a strong tempo throughout, particularly testing on the Soft going at Ffos Las. The sustained pace will expose stamina limitations and favour horses who can travel strongly in behind before delivering their challenge. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and prominent racers who can quicken off a solid pace, disadvantaging pure front-runners who may pay for early exertions.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Strong Pace Suits Closers
scenarios.trigger: If Barford Brook and Bebe And Bean engage in a genuine battle from flag-fall
scenarios.body: The honest gallop stretches the field and sets up perfect conditions for the stronger stayers to come from behind in the closing stages. Hold-up horses with proven stamina reserves will benefit most from the strong early tempo.

scenarios.label: B

scenarios.trigger: If one front-runner dominates early while the other settles behind
scenarios.body: The more controlled tempo allows the highest-rated horses to use their class advantage without being fully tested for stamina. Cinquenta's OR 124 and tactical speed become decisive factors in a more tactical affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Collapse Creates Opportunity
scenarios.trigger: If both front-runners fade dramatically in the closing stages after a fierce early battle
scenarios.body: The pace collapse opens the door for a mid-division runner to capitalise on the leaders' demise. Horses who can stay on strongly when others weaken will find themselves in prime position to strike.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If Bebe And Bean or Barford Brook get uncontested control of the early pace
scenarios.body: Without serious pressure, the leader conserves enough energy to resist late challenges on ground that will blunt finishing kicks. The tactical advantage of an uncontested lead proves decisive despite the Soft conditions.

races.paceDynamic: With confirmed leader Calli Black withdrawn, this becomes a messy pace puzzle with no obvious front-runner among the remaining 11. Boston Joe, Ezmerellda, L'Empire Vert, Ferando and Devilsrollthedice all want prominent positions, creating inevitable congestion and traffic problems through the mid-race. The lack of a natural leader means the early pace will be moderate before accelerating from 3 out when the prominent brigade starts jostling for position. This scrambled pace scenario strongly favours the hold-up horses who can sit off the traffic and deliver late challenges.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent quintet gets tangled up in traffic 2-3 out as predicted
scenarios.body: The patient riders on Italian Spirit, Just Aidan, Golden Millie, Manhattan Valley, Lunar Ocean and Dublin To Milan can pick their way through while the prominent horses compromise each other. Late-finishing types with tactical speed get the perfect setup.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Escapes Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If one of Boston Joe, L'Empire Vert or Ezmerellda breaks clear before the congestion hits
scenarios.body: That horse gets first run and holds off the late finishers who leave their challenge too late on the testing ground. The winner needs both early positioning luck and stamina to see out the trip.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If none of the prominent horses wants to make the running and they crawl through halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where class tells and the highest-rated horses with tactical pace prevail. Boston Joe's superior rating becomes decisive in a slowly-run tactical affair.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Complete Pace Meltdown
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion causes multiple fallers or significant interference 2 out
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery where only the horses who avoid trouble can win, regardless of ability or running style. Outsiders benefit from the chaos as favourites get hampered.

races.paceDynamic: Flemenstide will lead from the start with no genuine pace pressure in this small field, allowing him to dictate a sustainable gallop through the early stages. Vision De Maine, Mythe Bridge, Montmartin, Bridget Mary and The Magus will settle in behind in a compact group, while Bali Body and River Run Free drop to the rear. The lack of early pace will create a tactical affair that builds gradually, with the real race beginning after the final fence when Flemenstide's stamina reserves are tested. This controlled tempo strongly favours prominent runners who can track the leader and kick late, rather than hold-up horses who need a strong pace to close into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Controlled Pace Suits Trackers
scenarios.trigger: If Flemenstide maintains a steady but undemanding gallop to 3 out
scenarios.body: The moderate tempo allows prominent runners to conserve energy and produce sharp finishing kicks when it matters. Vision De Maine and Mythe Bridge are perfectly positioned to exploit this tactical setup with their proven ability to quicken off steady paces.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Early Pressure Changes Dynamic
scenarios.trigger: If Vision De Maine or Mythe Bridge press Flemenstide earlier than expected
scenarios.body: The increased tempo stretches the field and creates gaps for late closers to exploit in the final furlong. River Run Free and Bali Body benefit from the stronger gallop that plays to their hold-up style.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Flemenstide Surprises Field
scenarios.trigger: If Flemenstide's stamina proves superior and he maintains his lead throughout
scenarios.body: His light weight and front-running advantage combine effectively on the testing ground to hold off late challenges. The consistent leader proves hard to peg back when dictating his own terms.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Flemenstide goes too slowly and the race becomes a sprint from 2 out
scenarios.body: The tactical crawl becomes a test of pure acceleration rather than stamina, suiting horses with natural speed. The Magus and Montmartin benefit from their ability to produce sharp turns of foot.
